title: Magic 8-Ball Inertia & Gyroscope
tagline: Realistic fluid-buoyancy simulation inside a tactile 3D sphere.
description: A digital homage to the classic novelty toy. Simulates realistic viscous fluid drag on the internal icosahedron die floating in blue dye. Supports both drag-and-shake mouse velocity on desktop and native DeviceOrientation/DeviceMotion on smartphones.
interactiveDetails: Tactile haptic feedback (on supported mobile devices), spatial audio slosh sounds via Web Audio API, and dynamic text reveal on the floating die surface.
highlightMetricOrFeature: Dual Input: Mouse Velocity Inertia (Desktop) + Accelerometer Gyro (Mobile)
